guidedPractice.prompt: First find the target in context. Then make a parallel attempt from a cue; the completed response remains hidden until after the attempt.

progressiveHints.text: Choose one situation where you would naturally use command form / dictionary form + な / time + までに; do not write the whole sentence yet.
Build the sentence in parts: choose the content first, then check the form that carries understand strong instructions, prohibitions, and deadlines.
Compare your form, meaning, and commands are restricted to signs, emergencies, or strong authority with the worked model. Change the content so the response is your own.

retryFeedback.diagnostic: Check the form and meaning again. A common mix-up is this: a command form is forceful; 〜な prohibits, while までに sets a deadline
retryFeedback.retryPrompt: Revise one part at a time, then try again with your own content.
